misprints.probably_meant: a) ... b) (the a) sub-sense under 2) is missing)
misprints.note: Under Vidrighet 2) the print goes straight to b) with no a) before it; kept as printed.
The neuter ending has no accent in the print.

uncertain.text: τὸ δέ l. καὶ τὸ l. ὁ δὲ μέγιστον
uncertain.note: Read δέ as acute and ὁ as having a rough breathing only. A small accent on ὁ (ὃ) cannot be ruled out.
The ἦν (smooth breathing and circumflex) matches the print, though ἢν would make more sense. I kept the print's reading.
